# Game Idea: Asteroid Escape

- Control a small ship that can rotate and thrust on an HTML canvas.
- Asteroids spawn from the edges and drift in random directions.
- **Lose condition:** collision with any asteroid or moving off‑screen.
- Simple shapes (triangle ship, circle asteroids) keep implementation fast.

<content>
1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Ship state
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height / 2,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     vx: 0,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     radius: 10,
19:     thrust: false,
20:     rotateDir: 0, // -1 left, 1 right
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Asteroid list
24:   const asteroids = [];
25:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 2000; // ms
26:   const lastSpawn = { time: 0 };
27:   // Background stars for visual depth
28:   const stars = [];
29:   const starCount = 100;
30:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
31:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
32:   }
33: 
34:   // Input handling and sound setup
35:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, ArrowUp: false };
36:   // Audio context for sounds
37:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
38:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
39:   let thrustOsc = null;
40:   function startThrustSound() {
41:     if (thrustOsc) return;
42:     thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
43:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
44:     thrustOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, audioCtx.currentTime);
45:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
46:     thrustOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
47:     thrustOsc.start();
48:   }
49:   function stopThrustSound() {
50:     if (!thrustOsc) return;
51:     thrustOsc.stop();
52:     thrustOsc.disconnect();
53:     thrustOsc = null;
54:   }
55:   function playExplosionSound() {
56:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
57:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
58:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime);
59:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
60:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
61:     osc.start();
62:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
63:   }
64:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
65:     if (e.key in keys) {
66:       if (!keys[e.key]) {
67:         // key pressed newly
68:         if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') startThrustSound();
69:       }
70:       keys[e.key] = true;
71:     }
72:   });
73:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
74:     if (e.key in keys) {
75:       if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') stopThrustSound();
76:       keys[e.key] = false;
77:     }
78:   });
79: 
80:   function spawnAsteroid() {
81:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
82:     let x, y, vx, vy;
83:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
84:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
85:     switch (edge) {
86:       case 0: // top
87:         x = Math.random() * width; y = -size; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = speed; break;
88:       case 1: // right
89:         x = width + size; y = Math.random() * height; vx = -speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; break;
90:       case 2: // bottom
91:         x = Math.random() * width; y = height + size; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = -speed; break;
92:       case 3: // left
93:         x = -size; y = Math.random() * height; vx = speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; break;
94:     }
95:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: size });
96:   }
97: 
98:   function update(dt) {
99:     // Ship controls
100:     ship.rotateDir = 0;
101:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.rotateDir = -1;
102:     else if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.rotateDir = 1;
103:     ship.angle += ship.rotateDir * 0.005 * dt; // rotate speed
104:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
105:       const thrustPower = 0.001 * dt;
106:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrustPower;
107:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrustPower;
108:     }
109:     // Apply velocity
110:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
111:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
112: 
113:     // Lose if off-screen
114:     if (ship.x < 0 || ship.x > width || ship.y < 0 || ship.y > height) {
115:       gameOver();
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Update asteroids
119:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
120:       const a = asteroids[i];
121:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
122:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
123:       // Remove if far off-screen
124:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > width + 50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > height + 50) {
125:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
126:         continue;
127:       }
128:       // Collision with ship
129:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
130:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
131:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
132:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
133:         gameOver();
134:       }
135:     }
136: 
137:     // Spawn asteroids
138:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn.time > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
139:       spawnAsteroid();
140:       lastSpawn.time = performance.now();
141:     }
142:   }
143: 
144: function draw() {
145:     // Dark background
146:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
147:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
148:     // Draw stars for depth
149:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
150:     stars.forEach(s => {
151:       ctx.beginPath();
152:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
153:       ctx.fill();
154:     });
155:     // Draw ship (triangle) with optional thrust flame
156:     ctx.save();
157:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
158:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
159:     // Ship body with gradient
160:     ctx.beginPath();
161:     ctx.moveTo(ship.radius, 0);
162:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius / 2);
163:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius / 2);
164:     ctx.closePath();
165:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -ship.radius, 0, ship.radius);
166:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
167:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#060');
168:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
169:     ctx.fill();
170:     // Thrust flame when accelerating
171:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
172:       ctx.beginPath();
173:       ctx.moveTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius / 4);
174:       ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius - ship.radius, 0);
175:       ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius / 4);
176:       ctx.closePath();
177:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
178:       ctx.fill();
179:     }
180:     ctx.restore();
181:     // Draw asteroids with radial gradient
182:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
183:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
184:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
185:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
186:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
187:       ctx.beginPath();
188:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
189:       ctx.fill();
190:     });
191:   }
192:     ctx.restore();
193:     // Draw asteroids
194:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
195:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
196:       ctx.beginPath();
197:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
198:       ctx.fill();
199:     });
200:   }
201: 
202:   let lastTime = performance.now();
203:   let running = true;
204:   function loop() {
205:     if (!running) return;
206:     const now = performance.now();
207:     const dt = now - lastTime;
208:     lastTime = now;
209:     update(dt);
210:     draw();
211:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
212:   }
213:   function gameOver() {
214:     running = false;
215:     playExplosionSound();
216:     alert('Game Over');
217:   }
218: 
219:   // Start loop
220:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
221: })();

(End of file - total 221 lines)
</content>
